strengths: The implementation adds only P7 composition adapters and leaves Matter contracts, MW4 receiver/journal, canonical Item Graph implementation, persistence, network, and authority foundations unchanged.
Mass quantization is explicit: one generic V0 item/ore unit represents one kilogram; fractional remainder is exposed as residual_mass_kg rather than rounded away.
The existing canonical Item Graph replay ledger remains the sole exactly-once owner; no P7 replay or receipt ledger exists.
Replay fingerprint binds full immutable MatterMaterialBatch checksum, so a reused batch_id with altered physical contents fails closed.
A real MW4 lunar batch is delivered through the adapter in focused tests, including failure after Matter commit and retry against a different available Item Graph.
Unsupported material IDs fail closed instead of being silently coerced.

findings.summary: Initial candidate bound only a checksum prefix into server-output source identity.
findings.resolution: Final runtime HEAD binds the full immutable MatterMaterialBatch checksum into Item Graph replay fingerprint.

findings.summary: Current V0 Item Graph quantity is integer and generic item/ore has no physical mass field.
findings.resolution: P7.3 defines the conversion explicitly as product policy (1 kg/item unit), keeps fractional mass as immutable batch residual provenance, and does not claim Item Graph itself becomes a physical-mass store. Reviewer must judge this policy boundary.

findings.summary: P7.3 coordinator is not yet wired into the live graphical/two-client product path.
findings.resolution: Focused P7.3 exercises real MW4 + canonical Item Graph. P7.5 owns two-client convergence and P7.7 owns graphical digging/inventory composition; Reviewer must confirm this is a valid staged boundary rather than a missing P7.3 production caller.

findings.summary: Implementer container did not complete a fresh standalone P7.2 bubble process shutdown.
findings.resolution: No P7.2 production files changed in P7.3. Independent Verifier must run the full canonical P7.3 gate on fresh Ubuntu exact-double Godot before any merge decision.

bounded_questions.unnecessary_complexity: Three small components separate conversion policy, canonical Item Graph port, and request/result/batch provenance validation. Combining them would make product policy and owner boundary less auditable.
bounded_questions.duplicate_truth: None intended. Item Graph owns spendable integer inventory; MatterMaterialBatch remains immutable extraction provenance including any fractional residual.
bounded_questions.implicit_owner: No new stateful owner. Coordinator and adapter hold references only; policy is static.
bounded_questions.coupling_reduction: The adapter calls only the existing preflight_server_output/apply_server_output seam; no changes were made inside M4 Item Graph.
bounded_questions.sibling_surface_fix: P3 mining output, P5 tool mining, P7.1 authority, P7.2 seam, MW4, MW5 and MW6 were rerun by Implementer.
bounded_questions.removable_code: No prior production code was replaced or bypassed.
bounded_questions.design_regression: Primary review question is semantic, not structural: whether current V0 generic ore should intentionally collapse supported lunar geological composition under the explicit 1 kg/item policy.
bounded_questions.refactor_if_redesigned: If future Item definitions become composition-specific or mass-bearing, change only the P7 delivery policy mapping; do not add a second Item Graph or Matter balance.

open_blockers: Fresh independent Verifier after Reviewer PASS.
nonblocking_followups: P7.4 persistence restart must prove a committed undelivered batch can survive restart and later deliver exactly once.
P7.5/P7.7 must wire the accepted conversion boundary into two-client and graphical product composition.
